beats.intent: Brisk walk right on planted feet, the closing foot catches up and the weight settles

board.start: Dark grid, floor and parcel appearing, courier rising at the left
board.end: Courier has walked right and is stopping short of the parcel
board.why: the walk sets the courier moving toward the parcel

beats.intent: Stopped and breathing, then the eyes find the parcel first, head and torso follow

board.end: Pupils, head and torso turned down to the parcel
board.why: the courier's look moves the viewer's eye to the parcel before anything else happens

beats.intent: Crouch (anticipation), hop with arms up and a bang, land, settle, then the 1.2s closing hold

board.end: Courier landed and settled, the bang mark above
board.why: the bang closes the story and the settled pose holds still for 1.2s
